name: codex-notifier-telegram
description: Play a gentle sound, flash VS Code, and optionally notify Telegram when Codex work finishes.

codexNotifierTelegram.telegram.enabled.description: Send a Telegram message when Codex completion is detected. Requires the main notifier to be enabled.

codexNotifierTelegram.telegram.botToken.description: Telegram bot token from BotFather. Stored in plain text in settings.json; use User settings and do not commit this token.

codexNotifierTelegram.telegram.chatId.description: Telegram destination Chat ID (including the minus sign for groups), or a channel @username. Start your bot or add it to the destination chat first.

codexNotifierTelegram.playSound.description: Play a notification sound when Codex completion is detected.

codexNotifierTelegram.soundVolume.description: Notification sound volume as a percentage. Set to 0 to mute it.

codexNotifierTelegram.soundPath.description: Path to a custom notification audio file. Leave empty to use the bundled MP3. Relative paths are resolved from the first workspace folder. The 'Select Notification Sound' command imports a persistent copy into VS Code storage.

codexNotifierTelegram.flashMode.description: Visual completion alert. workbenchColors blinks a green 'Codex is done' status item and restores its temporary colors; editorOverlay is a compatibility alias.

codexNotifierTelegram.stopOnInteraction.description: Stop the visual alert when the VS Code window gains focus or the user interacts with editors or terminals.

codexNotifierTelegram.flashIntervalMs.description: Interval for each status bar pulse step.

codexNotifierTelegram.maxFlashSeconds.description: Maximum time the visual alert should continue if there is no interaction. Set to 0 or 1 to keep it active until interaction or dismissal.

codexNotifierTelegram.terminalCommandPat.description: JavaScript regular expression used to detect Codex CLI commands in terminals with shell integration.

codexNotifierTelegram.detectTerminalCode.description: Automatically alert when a matching terminal command ends. Requires VS Code terminal shell integration.

codexNotifierTelegram.detectCodexProcess.description: Automatically alert when a short-lived Codex process exits. Off by default because the OpenAI Codex extension app-server is long-lived and not one process per turn.

codexNotifierTelegram.detectOpenAiCodexL.description: Automatically alert when the OpenAI Codex extension reports that a turn has completed.

codexNotifierTelegram.openAiCodexDetecti.description: How to detect OpenAI Codex extension completion. chatHeuristic catches chat-only turns by correlating turn activity with the final read-state event; conservative only uses stronger local completion markers.

codexNotifierTelegram.processPollInterva.description: How often to check for Codex process start and exit.

codexNotifierTelegram.notifyWhenWindowFo.description: Show a small VS Code information notification when completion is detected.

codexNotifierTelegram.taskbarFlash.description: On Windows, flash the VS Code taskbar icon while the completion alert is active.

codexNotifierTelegram.workbenchColorTarg.description: Where temporary workbench color customizations are written when flashMode is workbenchColors. Workspace scope automatically falls back to global when no workspace is open.
